_meta.description: Custom Pokémon forms unique to the Celestide Isles. Loaded by the override layer (STO-22) at session start.
_meta.override_rules: For each entry: typing, ability, and signature_move replace the canon equivalents. All other base stats, learnset, and evolution methods use PokeAPI data for the base_canon_ref species unless explicitly overridden here.

resembles.note: Retains Mareep base stats and general learnset. Typing changed from Electric to Electric/Flying.

cstm_celestide_mareep.concept: Mareep adapted to floating isles where wool catches wind currents and tail orbs store celestial static. Cloud-like wool glows softly at night.
cstm_celestide_mareep.lore: Celestide Mareep are a beloved sight on Breeze Path — their wool drifts like small clouds and their tail orbs pulse with warm light. Locals say they sense wind shifts before storms. Evolves into Celestide Ampharos (Electric/Psychic) when exposed to stable crystal currents.
design_hooks: Cloud-like wool with soft blue-white glow
Tail orb pulses brighter in Tailwind
Hooves leave faint static trails on grass platforms
Baahs carry on the wind farther than canon Mareep

ability.name: Sky Baah
ability.description: Increases evasion by one stage while Tailwind is active on this Pokémon's side.

stat_overrides.note: Base stats identical to canon Mareep (330 total). Type changes only.

signature_move.name: Static Gust
signature_move.simple_effect: Releases a charged wind pulse. Deals Electric damage. In Tailwind, 20% chance to paralyze the target.

evolution.notes: Evolves into Flaaffy at level 15 (canon), then into Celestide Ampharos at level 30 while holding a Gravity Crystal Shard near a stable crystal current.

resembles.note: Retains Dreepy base stats and Dragon/Ghost typing. Celestide form reflects juvenile stage bonded to wind-current folklore.

cstm_dreepy_celestide.concept: Dreepy drawn to the Celestide Isles' crystal currents — shy juveniles that hide behind trusted trainers until they sense ancient Pokémon legends nearby.
cstm_dreepy_celestide.lore: Valion's partner Drift is a Celestide Dreepy — quiet, curious, and fascinated by ruins and legends carried on the wind. Unlike typical Dreepy, Celestide juveniles linger near gravity crystal harmonics. They evolve along the standard Dreepy line but retain a faint wind-trail when moving at speed.
design_hooks: Translucent tail leaves a faint wind-trail
Eyes reflect crystal-light colors at night
Hides behind trainer's legs when shy
Hums softly near ancient ruins or crystal caverns

ability.name: Celestial Current
ability.description: When entering battle on a route or wilderness location, this Pokémon's Speed rises one stage (wind-tuned reflexes).

stat_overrides.note: Base stats identical to canon Dreepy (270 total). Ability override only.

signature_move.name: Drift Lash
signature_move.simple_effect: Strikes with a ghostly tail riding a wind current. Always goes first when the user is below 50% HP (priority +1 in that case).

evolution.notes: Standard Dreepy evolution line (Dreepy → Drakloak → Dragapult). Celestide form is a regional juvenile presentation, not a separate species line.
